intention_examples: author intends to merge pull request
automation intends to deploy after checks pass
commitment_examples: reviewer commits to approve under required conditions
ci system commits to publish deterministic test result
merge bot commits to merge when branch protection predicates hold

conflict_shape.example: two concurrent intentions to merge incompatible histories
conflict_shape.expected_behavior: both intentions remain visible; downstream policy decides resolution

replay_shape.example: reconstruct repository/project coordination state from immutable records
replay_shape.expected_behavior: deterministic recomputation of open PRs, approvals, and unmet checks

notes: GitHub collaboration workflows reduce naturally to O/I/C with policy layered above runtime. No fourth primitive required for baseline modeling.
